mathematics.logical_review: The current n=1 proof derives word-Koszulity, AS translation 6 and all relation ranks from the stated AS/domain hypotheses, forces both mixed relation coefficients by the top Frobenius tensor, and obtains PBW and indexed two-step Ore structure by the exact Euler series. Independent AI-assisted readings checked the coefficient normalization, bare indexed isomorphism classification, period-one criterion, and reverse construction with an explicit two-sided AS3 proof. The period-two counterexample is a special case, so the universal ordinary-graded descent assertion is refuted. The general AS-translation and conditional normal-z and one-heavy Frobenius lemmas were independently reviewed, with all extra hypotheses retained. Earlier n=2 results and their exact mixed-rank proof assets remain valid within their scope. These checks are neither formal verification nor external peer review.
mathematics.scope: Over the standing algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, all Q_1^dom have a two-step indexed Ore normal form A(c,alpha,beta), with c nonzero and d_(2m)=c^(-m)alpha, d_(2m+1)=c^(-m)beta. Bare indexed isomorphism is c equality and common nonzero scaling of (alpha,beta); period one is equivalent to alpha^2=c beta^2, including the zero pair, and otherwise the least period is two. All reverse constructions are word-Koszul, AS3, left/right noetherian domains with standard Hilbert series. Thus universal descent to one graded algebra is false already at n=1. The existing n=2 domain two-step Ore/descent theorem is retained. Indexed Ore exhaustion and the missing numerical/base-AS assertions for n>=3 are not proved. No standard-Hilbert or noetherian assumption was silently added to the main target.

Opposite one-sided R_5 relations at distances 2 and 4 create forbidden cubic syzygies; distance 3 gives a verified monomial quotient with two prefix-distinct weight-42 code words and exponential row growth. No full exclusion of one-sided degeneration is asserted.
For n=1, the E^1/E^2 perfect pairing fixes top word length 3; domainness excludes weight-two and weight-six relations, so AS duality forces translation 6 and relation weights 3,4,5.

The two decompositions of the n=1 top Koszul tensor force both wx/xw coefficients nonzero; the exact resolution Euler recurrence yields the full standard Hilbert series, not only low-degree agreement.
General n=1 Ore compatibility is a_i c_i b_(i+2)=a_(i+3)b_i c_(i+1) and c_i d_(i+2)=a_(i+3)d_i. Normalization gives a=b=1, constant c and c d_(i+2)=d_i.

All residual word-linear basis changes preserve c and multiply the entire d sequence by one nonzero scalar. Augmentation-filtration linearization extends this existence criterion to bare indexed isomorphism.
The shift-one action is (alpha,beta)->(beta,c^(-1)alpha), giving alpha^2=c beta^2 as the exact period-one condition, including the zero pair. Shift two is always scalar-equivalent.
For the reverse construction, the sole PBW ambiguity, explicit differentials d1d2=d2d3=0 and both top tensor expansions were checked symbolically for both source parities with general parameters.
The w-count associated graded is the check algebra of k[x,z][w;tau], tau(x)=x, tau(z)=c z; it proves domainness and left/right noetherianity by leading terms and lifting finite generators.
Exact left and right Koszul resolutions and nondegenerate top pairings establish both AS conditions. The bimodule Koszul resolution bounds global dimension for all unital modules, not just simples.
The n=1 counterexample (c,alpha,beta)=(1,1,0) has alternating zz-projection ranks and cannot be check(D) for any single graded algebra D.
The general AS-translation lemma does not use Koszulity or determine L=n+5. The normal-z lemma assumes rank equality. The one-heavy lemma explicitly assumes the base B itself is Koszul ASn.

current_symbolic_audit.scope: Sole PBW overlap, partial_1 partial_2=0 and partial_2 partial_3=0, and equality of the two top Koszul tensor expansions, for both source parities.
current_symbolic_audit.parameters: c nonzero, alpha and beta arbitrary; d_(2m)=c^(-m)alpha and d_(2m+1)=c^(-m)beta.
current_symbolic_audit.arithmetic: Exact symbolic Laurent-polynomial identities using SymPy; no floating point or parameter sampling. The zero-alpha and zero-beta cases follow by specialization since only powers of c occur in denominators.
current_symbolic_audit.reproduction: The explicit relations, differential matrices and the two top tensor expansions are included in papers/nc-p1123.tex. This finite identity check is supplementary, not a computational premise of the proof.

retained_mixed_rank_proof.arithmetic: Integer Bareiss elimination with pivoting and exact-division checks; no floating point, random sampling or omitted cyclic representatives.

independent_audit.matrix_construction: Directly from all terms of the seven-row Koszul Euler polynomial, independently of the collapsed C_delta formula
